title: Verify accurate conversion between two currencies
gherkin:
Feature: Multi-currency conversion integrity
  Scenario: Convert amount from one currency to another with correct rate
    Given a conversion rate of 1 USD = 0.92 EUR
    When I convert 100 USD to EUR
    Then the result should be 92 EUR
    And the conversion should maintain precision to 2 decimal places
rationale: Ensures that basic currency conversions produce mathematically correct results using the provided exchange rate.
generationSummary: Multi-currency conversion integrity test suite covering accurate currency conversions, exchange rate handling, rounding precision, and data consistency across different currency pairs and conversion scenarios.

title: Verify conversion integrity with multiple currency pairs
gherkin:
Feature: Multi-currency conversion integrity
  Scenario: Convert between different currency pairs
    Given conversion rates:
      | From | To  | Rate  |
      | USD  | EUR | 0.92  |
      | USD  | GBP | 0.79  |
      | EUR  | GBP | 0.86  |
    When I convert 100 USD to EUR
    And I convert 100 USD to GBP
    And I convert 100 EUR to GBP
    Then all conversions should be mathematically consistent
rationale: Validates that conversions across multiple currency pairs maintain mathematical integrity and consistency.
generationSummary: Multi-currency conversion integrity test suite covering accurate currency conversions, exchange rate handling, rounding precision, and data consistency across different currency pairs and conversion scenarios.

title: Verify rounding precision in currency conversion
gherkin:

    And no precision loss should occur beyond the currency's decimal places

title: Verify bidirectional conversion consistency
gherkin:

    When I convert 100 USD to EUR resulting in 92 EUR
    And I convert 92 EUR back to USD

    And the difference should not exceed acceptable rounding tolerance

title: Verify conversion with updated exchange rates
gherkin:

    When the exchange rate is updated to 1 USD = 0.95 EUR
    And I convert 100 USD to EUR using the new rate
    Then the result should be 95 EUR
    And previous conversions should not be affected
